newsitem.title: USA: Standard Financial resumes search for site.
newsitem.headline: Standard Financial resumes search for site.

text.p: Standard Financial Inc said on Monday it decided to look further for a site for a new Homer Township branch office in Will County, Illinois.
The holding company for Standard Federal Bank for Savings of Chicago originally expected construction on the branch to begin in early 1997 and had tentatively settled on a site.

However, it said possible zoning issues and potential access problems for customers have prompted it to look elsewhere. "We had previously identified several other potential locations in the same area and will now re-examine those," said chairman David Mackiewich in a statement.
